title: Ravnica Allegiance Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who is guildmaster of the Orzhov.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: An Orzhov leader who waits at the center of the guild's web of power.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of priests and moneylenders whose sin is debt.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The council of ghost leaders of the Orzhov, ended by Kaya.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: Azorius renegade who warned Jace that Ravnica would fall apart.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who was told by Lavinia to take his responsibilities seriously.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane whose guilds are in conflict.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: Gruul-aligned planeswalker who calls for the city to be smashed.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker, a cruel conqueror.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: A Rakdos performer who calls for places on the stage.

entities.name: Tajic
entities.description: Boros figure who warns that the Cult of Rakdos is a danger.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of revelers and performers.

entities.name: Nikya of the Old Ways
entities.description: Gruul leader who speaks of the Raze-Boar and the End-Raze.

entities.name: Hilgur
entities.description: An Orzhov euthanist.

entities.name: Dasha
entities.description: An Orzhov priest.

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: Simic leader who speaks of one beginning and many paths.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of the undercity.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of secrets and spies.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of the Rubblebelt wilds.

entities.name: Gyre Clade
entities.description: A Simic clade that seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.

entities.name: Ilharg
entities.description: The Raze-Boar whose hooves will trample the city.

events.summary: The Golgari call upon an army that has slept beneath the city in preparation for the conflict all foresaw.
events.quote: the Golgari called upon an army that had slept for millennia beneath the city

events.summary: Nicol Bolas tells that no worthwhile reward is easily gained.
events.quote: No worthwhile reward is easily gained.

events.summary: Domri Rade calls for the city to be smashed to pieces.
Lavinia recalls telling Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he did not take his responsibilities seriously.
events.quote: I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously.

events.summary: Kaya tells Teysa it is time to let the dead be dead.
events.quote: Time to let the dead be dead.

events.summary: Teysa convenes a meeting of the Obzedat and Kaya ends it.
Nikya foretells the Raze-Boar trampling the weak and the city.
events.quote: The hooves of the Raze-Boar will trample the weak

relations.note: Kaya is guildmaster of the Orzhov.
Teysa sits at the center of the Orzhov web of power.
relations.quote: Teysa waits patiently at the center of the Orzhov web of power
